children: Brookfield announced a $1bn initial commitment to manage a long-term, multi-asset mandate for the Nuclear Liabilities Fund.
Selected by Nuclear Liabilities Fund to manage a multi-decade, multi-asset investment mandate.
Initial $1bn (c. £750m) commitment to be invested across Brookfield’s global strategies.
Mandate run by Investment Solutions Group to use infrastructure, energy, private equity, real estate and credit.
Portfolio structured to reinvest proceeds to support long-term compounding and meet future decommissioning costs.
